title: METAIS cross-platform record
description: What one run of the suite observed on one target, by digest: the tool, the target, the suite, and for every invocation of every step of every case in each environment, the result and the SHA-256 and length of every byte it produced. Records of one build on different targets agree in every member but target. No sandbox path appears in a record.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: The implementation's name and version, as it reports them.

target.title: Target
target.description: The operating system and architecture the suite ran on, as <os>/<arch>.

suite_sha256.title: Suite digest
suite_sha256.description: The SHA-256, in lower-case hexadecimal, of the lines "<path> <sha256>" each ended by LF, one per regular file below the suite directory, sorted, with slash-separated paths relative to it.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: One entry per invocation, sorted by vector, case, step, invocation and environment.

skipped.title: Skipped cases
skipped.description: The cases skipped for a requirement the target's file system does not meet, sorted by vector and case. Two records are compared on the cases both ran.

blob.title: Bytes
blob.description: The SHA-256 and length of some bytes.

step.title: Step
step.description: One invocation of one step of one case in one environment.

invocation.description: 1, or the position of the command among those a hostile open step runs.

files.description: Every regular file of the step's declared trees, by path from the work directory.
